apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(skin): pad dropdown fields so the value text stays inside the pill (`898070eb`)
- fix(host): let the skin nav bar handle touch drags so the pill follows the finger (`9255ce91`)
- fix(skin): drop hover nav labels outside desktop so the selection pill centers (`f5fa4f40`)
- fix(host): stop skin screens inheriting focus onto text inputs (`cd941f4c`)
- fix(skin): pad by each real inset and keep fixed overlays inside the safe area (`cd50a58b`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluxaMedia/fluxa/compare/v0.3.10...v0.3.11
